turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning. What brings you in today?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: It's my diabetes review. My sugars have mostly been fine.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Which medicines are you taking at the moment?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I take metformin 500 mg twice a day, and I'm on atorvastatin 20 mg at night.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your HbA1c is 52, which is good. We'll keep everything the same and review you in six months.
